description: Exploit; this combines the E009 near-miss with extra epochs. Start from the E007 Muon incumbent (128/384/576, Muon lr 0.24 / momentum 0.6 / 3 NS steps, batch 2000, ls 0.3, alternating flip, max-autotune, subset whitening). Cut group 1 from 3 convs to 2, exactly as in E009 (same pooling position, width 128). Raise epochs from 9.0 to 9.5 (about 238 steps) and stretch the LR schedule to match. Change nothing else. Warm up the new shapes in build. Log ms/step and per-seed accuracy.
